builds.note: earlier full builds: 16.3s and 13.2s; 6882-of-6883 then home page built separately

notes: Nift built the entire 6,883-page corpus comfortably on a 1 vCPU / 2 GB VPS with ~10-22 MB peak RSS.
This contrasts with the Astro build which required 8+ GB RSS on a 6 vCPU / 16 GB instance, but the machines are not equivalent; treat only as operational evidence.
Full clean-build wall time on this VPS is ~15-16 s; no-op rebuild ~2.5 s.
